final: WITH store_counts AS (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(customer_count) AS total_count FROM store_counts), store_shares AS (SELECT sc.store_id, sc.customer_count, 1.0 * sc.customer_count / t.total_count AS store_share FROM store_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL), averages AS (SELECT AVG(store_share) AS average_share FROM store_shares) SELECT ss.store_id, ss.customer_count, ss.store_share, ss.store_share - a.average_share AS share_difference FROM store_shares AS ss CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE a.average_share IS NOT NULL AND ss.store_share > a.average_share ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
